paragraphs: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chaluka or bar Chilkiyah.
In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the printed locator קפ: (180:), he appears under the name Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chaluka. The statement appears in Vayikra Rabbah 30:3.
There it is attributed to Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chilkiyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The two patronymic readings name the person under discussion; they do not make him report a teaching in his own name.

The complete Vayikra Rabbah 30:3 scalar names Rabbi Yitzchak berabbi Chilkiyah. Hyman reports the Chaluka form at the historical Pesikta locator קפ:. Its edition and page-versus-folio convention have not been established, and the intended Pesikta passage remains unresolved. The patronymic forms and title before the father remain source-specific.
